page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c2.medium is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. It contains zero GPUs and does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The hardware profile represents a compute-heavy allocation with a low memory-to-vCPU ratio. This design is cost-efficient for workloads requiring significant processing power without large memory footprints, though it presents a tradeoff for memory-intensive applications or those requiring local high-speed disk I/O.

Appropriate workloads for this configuration include batch processing, CPU-bound web serving, microservices, and distributed analytics tasks that do not require local caching or large in-memory datasets.
